states.name: IDLE
states.description: Blower OFF. Start timer reset whenever permit is FALSE. Waiting for a valid demand and safety permissive.
actions: BLOWER_RUN remains FALSE through final output stage
No cycle count increment

states.name: DELAY
states.description: Valid demand exists: DO_LOW = TRUE and AERATION_E_STOP_NC = TRUE. Start-delay timer is accumulating. Blower remains OFF until 5 s has elapsed.
actions: StartDelayTON.IN = permit
BLOWER_RUN remains FALSE until StartDelayTON.Q = TRUE

states.name: RUN
states.description: Delayed start complete and permissive still TRUE. Blower run command is enabled through the output stage.
actions: BLOWER_RUN remains TRUE only while permit remains TRUE
Cycle count increments only on FALSE-to-TRUE edge of BLOWER_RUN

transitions.condition: DO_LOW = TRUE AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC = TRUE AND StartDelayTON.Q = TRUE
transitions.note: The final output stage also uses the post-call StartDelayTON.Q so BLOWER_RUN can assert on the same scan the 5 s delay is reached.

actions: Force BLOWER_RUN = FALSE
Reset StartDelayTON
Force BLOWER_RUN = FALSE immediately
Reset StartDelayTON
Retain AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT

timer_plan.name: StartDelayTON
timer_plan.q_usage: Delay-done permissive. BLOWER_RUN may be TRUE only when permit is TRUE and StartDelayTON.Q is TRUE, or while latched in RUN with permit TRUE.
timer_plan.et_usage: Elapsed time monitor/debug. First eligible sampled invocation starts at 0 ms; Q becomes TRUE when ET >= 5000 ms.
non_reset_conditions: Do not reset solely because state changes from DELAY to RUN while permit remains TRUE; keeping the timer active preserves delay-done while running.
timer_plan.call_constraint: Call exactly once per scan as an unconditional top-level FB call outside CASE/IF.

priorities.name: Emergency stop / safety permissive
priorities.rule: If AERATION_E_STOP_NC = FALSE, force BLOWER_RUN = FALSE immediately, reset StartDelayTON, and block any delayed-start or run transition.

priorities.name: Loss of dissolved-oxygen demand
priorities.rule: If DO_LOW = FALSE, force BLOWER_RUN = FALSE immediately, reset StartDelayTON, and require a new full 5 s delay before any future start.

priorities.name: Delayed-start gate
priorities.rule: BLOWER_RUN cannot become TRUE until DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC have remained TRUE continuously for 5000 ms.

priorities.name: Cycle counting
priorities.rule: Increment AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT only on the FALSE-to-TRUE transition of the final end-of-scan BLOWER_RUN output. Do not count during power-up, while stopped, or during continuous run.

priorities.name: Unified output assignment
priorities.rule: Write BLOWER_RUN and AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT only in the final scan stage, after safety override, state logic, and timer execution.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
actions: Sample inputs once: DO_LOW and AERATION_E_STOP_NC.
Compute permit := DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC.
Sample previous observed blower output for edge detection: runPrev := BLOWER_RUN, where BLOWER_RUN is the pre-scan retained output O[k-1].
Do not update AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT in this stage.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: Apply highest-priority safety reset first: if permit = FALSE, force state := IDLE and set runCmd := FALSE.
Otherwise evaluate state transitions: IDLE -> DELAY when permit = TRUE; DELAY -> RUN when permit = TRUE and StartDelayTON.Q = TRUE; DELAY/RUN -> IDLE when permit = FALSE.
State logic may set internal state/run intent but must not write final BLOWER_RUN or AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT outputs.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: Call StartDelayTON(IN := permit, PT := T#5s) exactly once per scan.
If permit = FALSE, the TON resets: Q := FALSE and ET := 0 ms.
If permit = TRUE, the TON accumulates elapsed time and sets Q := TRUE when ET >= 5000 ms.
Do not call the timer inside CASE/IF or conditionally.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
actions: Compute final run command: runCmd := permit AND ((state = RUN) OR (state = DELAY AND StartDelayTON.Q)); if permit = FALSE then runCmd := FALSE.
If runCmd = TRUE AND runPrev = FALSE then cycleCount := cycleCount + 1.
Assign BLOWER_RUN := runCmd.
Assign AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT := cycleCount.
No other stage writes BLOWER_RUN or AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT.
